rules.title: Invented Radzen API
rules.why: Members that do not exist in the installed Radzen.Blazor version compile-fail at best and silently misbehave at worst (for example an unknown attribute captured by an attribute splat).
rules.fix: Look the member up through the Radzen MCP, record MCP-### evidence, and let G5 prove it compiles. Never copy members from other component libraries.
rules.bad: <RadzenDataGrid SmartPaging="true" RowsPerPageSelector="10,20" />   @* members that do not exist *@

rules.title: Data grid bound to a fully materialized collection
rules.why: A grid with Data= and no LoadData pages, sorts and filters in the browser/circuit after loading every row. Fine for small bounded lists; a performance and memory problem for unbounded data.
rules.fix: Use LoadData with server-side paging/sorting/filtering, Count and IsLoading. If the collection is provably bounded, waive with the bound as reason.
rules.mcpQuery: RadzenDataGrid LoadData server-side paging sorting filtering with Count and IsLoading
rules.message: RadzenDataGrid uses Data= without LoadData; confirm the data is bounded or switch to server-side LoadData.

rules.title: LoadData without Count
rules.why: Without Count the pager cannot know the total number of rows; paging breaks or shows one page only.
rules.fix: Set Count to the total number of matching rows returned by the server query.
rules.mcpQuery: RadzenDataGrid LoadData Count total rows paging

rules.title: Server query built from the raw filter string
rules.why: LoadDataArgs.Filter is an expression string generated in the browser. Passing it into a server-side dynamic query or an OData/query-string parameter lets a client shape the query.
rules.fix: Translate the structured filters (LoadDataArgs.Filters / column filter values) into typed query parameters, or use the Radzen helpers against the grid columns on a trusted IQueryable. Validate allowed fields and operators on the server.
rules.good: var query = new CustomerQuery(args.Skip, args.Top, nameFilter);
rules.mcpQuery: RadzenDataGrid LoadDataArgs Filters FilterDescriptor server-side query without Filter string

rules.title: Dialog/notification services without component host
rules.why: DialogService and NotificationService only render when <RadzenComponents /> (or the individual hosts in older versions) is in the layout; otherwise calls silently do nothing.
rules.fix: Add <RadzenComponents /> to the main layout with the correct @rendermode (see profile).
rules.mcpQuery: Radzen Blazor RadzenComponents host DialogService NotificationService

rules.title: Radzen services not registered
rules.why: Components that inject DialogService, NotificationService, TooltipService or ContextMenuService throw at runtime when the services are not registered.
rules.fix: Call builder.Services.AddRadzenComponents() in every host that renders Radzen components (server and WebAssembly client).

rules.title: Dialog result used without null check
rules.why: OpenAsync returns null when the user closes the dialog (Esc, X, Cancel). Casting or dereferencing the awaited result directly throws.
rules.fix: Pattern-match the result: if (await Dialogs.OpenAsync<Edit>(...) is Customer saved) { ... }.
rules.mcpQuery: Radzen DialogService OpenAsync result when dialog is closed

rules.title: Grid reload inside a loop
rules.why: Each Reload triggers LoadData and a render; calling it per item multiplies server calls.
rules.fix: Perform the batch operation, then call Reload once.

rules.title: Theme registered twice
rules.why: Combining <RadzenTheme> with a hard-coded theme stylesheet loads two themes; styles conflict and runtime theme switching breaks.
rules.fix: Use one mechanism, following the profile (radzen.theme).

rules.title: Hand-built controls where Radzen is the standard
rules.why: Raw <table>/<input> markup next to Radzen components creates inconsistent look, keyboard behaviour and accessibility.
rules.fix: Use the repository wrapper or the Radzen component, unless there is a documented reason.

rules.title: Floating Radzen.Blazor version
rules.why: Wildcard versions change the component API between builds; evidence recorded for one version may not hold for the next.
rules.fix: Pin the version (or pin it centrally in Directory.Packages.props).

rules.title: Overriding Radzen internal CSS classes
rules.why: Styling internal rz-* classes couples the app to Radzen internals that can change between versions.
rules.fix: Use theme variables (CSS custom properties) or component Style/CssClass parameters.

rules.title: Component host without interactive render mode
rules.why: With per-page render modes, a <RadzenComponents /> host without @rendermode renders statically, so dialogs, notifications and tooltips never appear.
rules.fix: Give the host the application render mode: <RadzenComponents @rendermode="InteractiveAuto" />.

rules.title: LoadData grid without loading state
rules.why: Without IsLoading the grid shows stale or empty rows while the server call runs.
rules.fix: Bind IsLoading and set it around the server call.

rules.title: Interactive component on a static page
rules.why: In a Blazor Web App, pages without an interactive render mode are static SSR: Radzen events (Click, Change, LoadData) never fire.
rules.fix: Apply the render mode used by the analogous feature (@rendermode or the global Routes render mode).
rules.message: Reported by project detection (health RND-H01); review the changed page render mode.
rules.tool: profile health RND-H01 + manual review of the changed page

rules.title: Data loaded twice because of prerendering
rules.why: With prerendering, OnInitializedAsync runs on the server prerender and again when the component becomes interactive: two backend calls and a flicker.
rules.fix: Persist prerendered state (PersistentComponentState / [PersistentState]) or follow the repository approach; for LoadData grids, remember LoadData is not raised during prerender.

rules.title: JavaScript interop during initialization
rules.why: JS interop is not available during prerendering; calls in OnInitialized(Async) throw.
rules.fix: Move interop to OnAfterRenderAsync(firstRender).

rules.title: async void method
rules.why: Exceptions from async void are not observed by Blazor’s error handling and can crash the circuit; the renderer also cannot await the handler.
rules.fix: Return Task (Blazor awaits Task-returning event handlers).

rules.title: Blocking on async code
rules.why: .Result, .Wait() and GetAwaiter().GetResult() block the renderer thread and can deadlock (always on WebAssembly).
rules.fix: await the task.

rules.title: StateHasChanged inside a loop
rules.why: Re-rendering per iteration is expensive and rarely needed.
rules.fix: Update state, then call StateHasChanged once (or rely on the automatic render after the handler).

rules.title: Missing @key on dynamic lists
rules.why: Without @key, re-ordered lists re-use component instances and state leaks between rows.
rules.fix: Add @key with a stable identifier in loops that render components.

rules.title: UI visibility used as authorization
rules.why: Hiding or disabling a button does not stop a user calling the operation. The browser is not a trusted boundary.
rules.fix: Enforce the policy at the server/application boundary (endpoint, application service). UI checks are UX only. Record the enforcement point in the spec authorization matrix.
rules.bad: <AuthorizeView Roles="Admin"><RadzenButton Click="@Delete" /></AuthorizeView>  (DELETE endpoint has no policy)

rules.title: Endpoint used by a new screen lacks authorization
rules.why: A new UI often calls an existing endpoint that was internal or anonymous.
rules.fix: Check every endpoint in the feature trace for [Authorize]/RequireAuthorization or a fallback policy; add a policy in scope when missing.

rules.title: Exception details shown to users
rules.why: Exception messages and stack traces leak internals (SQL, paths, tokens).
rules.fix: Show a safe message; log the exception with correlation id; follow the repository error contract (ProblemDetails).

rules.title: Credentials in configuration files
rules.why: Passwords in connection strings in tracked configuration end up in source control and build artifacts.
rules.fix: Use user secrets, environment variables, managed identity or a secret store.

rules.title: Radzen MCP key committed
rules.why: The X-Radzen-Key licence key grants MCP access to anyone who reads the repository.
rules.fix: Remove the key, rotate it, reference RADZEN_MCP_KEY or an input prompt (mcp/templates).

rules.title: AllowAnonymous on a feature page or endpoint
rules.why: Anonymous access on a page or endpoint that belongs to a protected feature bypasses the fallback policy.
rules.fix: Remove it, or record the approved reason as a waiver.

rules.title: Rendering raw HTML
rules.why: MarkupString renders unencoded HTML; user-controlled content becomes an XSS vector.
rules.fix: Render text normally, or sanitize with an approved sanitizer and waive with reason.

rules.title: Over-fetching sensitive data
rules.why: Returning full entities to the UI exposes fields the screen does not need.
rules.fix: Project to a DTO with only the fields in the spec data requirements.

rules.title: Antiforgery disabled
rules.why: Disabling antiforgery on forms or endpoints enables CSRF.
rules.fix: Keep antiforgery; for APIs use token-based auth where antiforgery does not apply.

rules.title: Secrets written to logs
rules.why: Tokens and passwords in logs are readable by anyone with log access.
rules.fix: Log identifiers, not secrets.

rules.title: Persistence entity bound directly to a form
rules.why: Binding EF entities to forms leaks persistence concerns into UI, risks over-posting and tracks changes unintentionally.
rules.fix: Bind a view model/DTO and map it in the application layer, as the repository does.
rules.message: Form TItem is an EF entity type (DbSet<{0}>).
rules.tool: scanner: TItem compared with DbSet<T> entity types

rules.title: Submit without busy/double-submit protection
rules.why: Users can submit twice while the first request runs, creating duplicates.
rules.fix: Disable the submit button while busy (RadzenButton IsBusy/Disabled) and ignore re-entrant submits.

rules.title: Client-only validation
rules.why: Validation in the component only improves UX; the server must enforce business rules.
rules.fix: Confirm the trusted layer validates the same rules (discovery → validation).

rules.title: Swallowed exception
rules.why: An empty catch hides failures; the UI shows success while the operation failed.
rules.fix: Handle the specific exception, show a safe message, log it; or let it propagate to the error boundary.

rules.title: Template form without validators
rules.why: A RadzenTemplateForm without validators submits invalid input and shows no field messages.
rules.fix: Add Radzen validators or the DataAnnotations validator used by the repository.

rules.title: Materialize, then query
rules.why: Calling ToList() before Where/Skip/Take/OrderBy/Count loads the whole table into memory.
rules.fix: Compose the query on IQueryable and materialize last.

rules.title: Loading everything in a component
rules.why: GetAll-style calls from components assume a small dataset.
rules.fix: Use a paged/filtered query; if the set is bounded, waive with the bound.

rules.title: Client-side aggregation of large data
rules.why: Summing or grouping raw rows in the browser for dashboards is slow and leaks detail data.
rules.fix: Aggregate on the server and return only the metrics.

rules.title: Async call per row in a template
rules.why: Awaiting a service call inside a column or row template runs once per row per render (N+1).
rules.fix: Load the required data with the page query (projection) or in one batch call.

rules.title: Search on every keystroke without debounce
rules.why: Calling the server on each input event floods the backend and returns results out of order.
rules.fix: Debounce (e.g. Radzen FilterDelay / a timer) and cancel the previous request.

rules.title: new HttpClient()
rules.why: Creating HttpClient per call exhausts sockets and bypasses configured handlers (auth, resilience).
rules.fix: Inject a typed client / IHttpClientFactory as the repository does.

rules.title: Icon-only button without accessible name
rules.why: Screen readers announce an unlabeled button as "button".
rules.fix: Add Text, or title plus aria-label.
rules.good: <RadzenButton Icon="delete" title="Delete customer" aria-label="Delete customer" Click="@Delete" />
rules.mcpQuery: Radzen Blazor RadzenButton accessibility aria-label icon only

rules.title: Colour as the only signal
rules.why: Status shown only by colour is invisible to colour-blind users.
rules.fix: Add text or an icon with a label.

rules.title: Image without alt text
rules.why: Images without alt are announced by file name or skipped without context.
rules.fix: Add alt (empty alt="" for decorative images).

rules.title: Input without label
rules.why: Inputs need a programmatic label (RadzenFormField Text, RadzenLabel Component, or aria-label).
rules.fix: Wrap inputs in RadzenFormField or associate a RadzenLabel.

rules.title: Positive tabindex
rules.why: Positive tabindex breaks the natural focus order.
rules.fix: Use DOM order; tabindex 0 or -1 only.

rules.title: Large fixed pixel column widths
rules.why: Fixed widths of hundreds of pixels force horizontal scrolling on small screens.
rules.fix: Give priority columns flexible widths; hide or collapse secondary columns at small breakpoints.

rules.title: Side-by-side master-detail on narrow screens
rules.why: Two grids next to each other are unusable on mobile.
rules.fix: Stack or navigate between master and detail at small breakpoints.

rules.title: Dialog with large fixed width
rules.why: Fixed-width dialogs overflow small viewports.
rules.fix: Use relative widths or max-width, following the repository dialog options.

rules.title: Very large fixed inline width
rules.why: Inline widths over 1000px break layouts on anything but wide desktops.
rules.fix: Use layout components (RadzenRow/Column, RadzenStack) and relative units.

rules.title: Unapproved dependency
rules.why: New packages, projects or framework references change the architecture and supply chain.
rules.fix: List the change under "Approved dependency changes" in plan.md, or remove it.

rules.title: Wrapper without stable value
rules.why: A thin wrapper around one Radzen component adds indirection without behaviour.
rules.fix: Use the Radzen component directly unless the wrapper enforces a repository convention.

rules.title: Unrelated refactoring inside a slice
rules.why: Mixed changes are hard to review and roll back.
rules.fix: Keep the slice to its tasks; record other findings as out-of-scope.

rules.title: Repairing brownfield inconsistencies during feature work
rules.why: Fixing unrelated architecture during a feature expands scope silently.
rules.fix: Record under out-of-scope findings in discovery.md.

rules.title: Data access from components
rules.why: Injecting a DbContext into UI bypasses the application/service layer, validation and authorization.
rules.fix: Call the service/client used by the analogous feature. If the repository deliberately uses DbContext in components, waive with that evidence.

rules.title: Global state for local state
rules.why: Introducing a store for state that belongs to one component adds complexity.
rules.fix: Keep local state in the component or follow the repository state pattern.

rules.title: Skipped or ignored tests
rules.why: Skipping tests to make a gate pass hides regressions.
rules.fix: Fix the test or the code; if a skip is legitimate and pre-existing, waive with the issue link.

rules.title: Brittle markup snapshots
rules.why: Snapshotting full Radzen markup breaks on every Radzen upgrade.
rules.fix: Assert behaviour (text, state, callbacks) unless snapshots are the repository convention.

rules.title: Deleted tests
rules.why: Removing tests in a feature change hides regressions.
rules.fix: Restore them or record an approved reason.
rules.message: Test file deleted in this change: {0}

rules.title: Skipping discovery
rules.why: Designing without the repository model produces foreign architecture.
rules.fix: Run phase 01; G1 must pass before specify.

rules.title: Changing package versions to fix compile errors
rules.why: Upgrading Radzen.Blazor to make MCP guidance compile changes scope and risk.
rules.fix: Follow the fallback matrix; propose upgrades as separate scope.

rules.title: Suppressing warnings or analyzers
rules.why: Suppressions hide the problems gates are meant to find.
rules.fix: Fix the warning. Pre-existing suppressions are fine; new ones need a waiver with reason.

rules.title: Claiming a gate passed without evidence
rules.why: Unverified claims make gate reports meaningless.
rules.fix: Report only what specs/NNN/gates/G#.json says.

rules.title: Inventing facts
rules.why: Unknown facts written as known mislead later phases.
rules.fix: Mark unknown; cite evidence for every fact.

rules.title: Asking trivial clarification questions
rules.why: Questions the repository already answers waste the user’s time.
rules.fix: Decide by convention and record the evidence.

rules.title: Unrecorded MCP knowledge
rules.why: Knowledge used without an evidence entry cannot be reviewed or re-verified.
rules.fix: Record every answer that informs code with speckit-radzen evidence add.

rules.title: Waiver without reason
rules.why: A waiver without a reason cannot be reviewed; it turns a finding into silence.
rules.fix: Add reason="…" (what makes this acceptable, and who approved it).
rules.good: @* speckit-radzen:ignore AP-RDZ-02 reason="lookup table, max 12 rows" *@
